tos_sec1_p1: The ATG – All-Time Greats application (hereinafter: application) is developed and operated by the 404 not found team. Contact: the.offical.404.not.found.team@gmail.com. By logging in, you accept these terms and the Privacy Policy.
tos_sec2_p1: The application also involves alcoholic beverages, therefore it is intended exclusively for users over 18 years of age. By logging in, you declare that you are over 18.
tos_sec3_p1: The application provides a shared interface for friend groups: tracking shared costs/debts, plans, calendar, drink suggestions and tier lists, as well as an in-group picture gallery.
tos_sec4_p1: You alone, as the uploader, bear responsibility for uploaded images, texts, and other content. Uploading the following content is prohibited: illegal, rights-violating, harassing, or offensive content.
tos_zero_tolerance: Zero tolerance: uploading content depicting or promoting child sexual exploitation and abuse (CSAE/CSAM) is strictly prohibited. Such content results in immediate removal and account deletion.
tos_sec5_p1: If you violate the above rules, we will remove the infringing content and may suspend or delete your account. If you find infringing content, write to the above email address.
tos_sec6_p1: The application does not encourage alcohol consumption and does not provide medical advice. Content related to drinks is for informational purposes.
tos_sec7_p1: The Debts module is solely for informational record-keeping among users. The application does not perform financial transactions and assumes no responsibility for settlement disputes.
tos_sec8_p1: The application is provided by the operator on an "as-is" basis, without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, the operator assumes no liability for damages resulting from data loss, service interruptions, or errors.
tos_sec9_p1: We may modify these terms from time to time. You will be notified of material changes within the application, and modified terms will require new acceptance (versioned acceptance upon login).
tos_sec10_p1: Handling of your data is governed by the Privacy Policy. You can read about deleting your account on the Delete Account page.
del_intro: The ATG – All-Time Greats application is developed and operated by the 404 not found team. The description below explains how you can delete your account and associated data.
del_sec1_step2: Open the Profile menu (by clicking the top-right avatar).
del_sec1_step3: Select the Delete Account button at the bottom of the menu.
del_sec1_step4: Confirm deletion in the appearing modal window.
del_sec1_p1: Deletion is immediate and permanent: your profile linked to your Google account, your display name, and your group membership are deleted from the database. If you are the only member of your group, all group data (debts, plans, events, drinks/tier list, uploaded pictures) is also permanently deleted.
del_sec1_warning: If you are the administrator of your group and there are other members: before deleting your account, first transfer admin rights to another member in the Profile → Group Data menu, otherwise deletion will fail (the group would remain without an admin).
del_sec2_title: 2. Requesting Deletion If You Cannot Access the Application
del_sec2_p1: If for any reason you cannot log in (e.g. you deleted your Google account, or you cannot reach the app due to a technical error), you can request the deletion of your account and associated data via email:
del_sec2_step1: Send an email to the.offical.404.not.found.team@gmail.com address with the subject "Fiók törlése - ATG".
del_sec2_step2: Specify which Google account (email address) belongs to the profile to be deleted.
del_sec2_step3: We will process the request within 14 days and confirm the deletion via email.
del_sec3_p1: During deletion, we remove your profile linked to your Google account (display name), your group membership, and – if you were the last member – all data of your group, including uploaded pictures. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. You can also revoke ATG's access anytime in your Google Account under Third-party apps with account access.
del_questions: If you have any questions, write to the the.offical.404.not.found.team@gmail.com address.
